items.title: IDOR: unlink_voice_device deactivates any device by ID with no owner/org scoping
evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/ai.rs:3002 — unlink_voice_device binds `_principal: RequestPrincipal` but ignores it, calling deactivate_voice_device(id) with only the path id
wired at ai.rs:2059 — DELETE /api/v1/ai/llm/voice/devices/{id} -> unlink_voice_device
backend/crates/db/src/repositories/llm_document.rs:1141 — `UPDATE voice_assistant_devices SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1` has no org/owner predicate
any authenticated principal can deactivate another tenant's voice device by guessing/enumerating the UUID (IDOR / cross-tenant write)
found by rotating expert review (Rust), full call path traced from the wired Axum route to the unscoped UPDATE
